tools.name: search
tools.description: One search across companies, summarised results and call transcripts, for open questions (ChatGPT deep research and connectors use this with fetch). Companies named in the question (by ticker or name) scope the search. Returns up to 20 ids with a title and snippet; pass an id to fetch for the full t

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Full text for an id from search: company:TICKER (profile, quarter list, latest results), quarter:TICKER/KEY (one quarter's results) or passage:TICKER/KEY#t-N (about 25 transcript paragraphs around the moment).

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Find covered companies and their tickers, latest quarter and next expected report date, sorted by name. Filter by query (name, ticker, sector, country or exchange words), sector or country. Pages of 50 by default (up to 200); total and next_offset tell you whether there are more. Unknown sectors or

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A company's profile (sector, country, reporting currency, fiscal year end, next expected report) and every quarter we have, newest first, with the quarter keys get_quarter and get_transcript take, and whether each has a transcript. Accepts a ticker or a name.

tools.name: get_kpis
tools.description: Quarterly KPI history calculated from SEC XBRL filings, newest first, in USD: revenue, gross_profit, operating_income, net_income, eps_diluted, operating_cash_flow, capex, free_cash_flow, rd_expense, gross_margin, operating_margin, net_margin (margins in percent, EPS in USD per share). Only SEC file

tools.name: get_quarter
tools.description: One quarter's results: headline, overview, reported figures (metrics: value as printed, number in currency units, ISO currency, unit currency|per_share|percent) with their source sentence, segments, outlook, a check of last quarter's outlook against what was reported, takeaways, management quotes, a

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: An earnings call transcript with speakers, timestamps and links, one page at a time: 40 paragraphs or about 12k characters by default, whichever comes first (limit up to 150). Pass next_offset as offset for the next page; total is the paragraph count. To find one moment, search_transcripts is cheape

tools.name: search_transcripts
tools.description: Exact words said on earnings calls (full-text, verbatim): each hit has the speaker, a snippet and a link to the moment, plus the ticker and quarter key for get_transcript. Use it for 'what did the CEO say about X'. Only calls with a published transcript are searched (about 300 quarters); for themes

tools.name: search_earnings
tools.description: Themes across companies' summarised results (all ~400 companies, not only those with transcripts): takeaways, outlook statements, management quotes and analyst questions with answers, newest-ranked by relevance. Use it for 'which companies talk about tariffs / AI capex / deposit costs'. Filter by ti

tools.name: list_recent
tools.description: Quarterly results reported in the last N days (default 14, up to 120), newest first, with the ticker and quarter key for get_quarter. limit 1-100, default 25.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_company, get_transcript, search_transcripts, search_earnings · Private data: get_quarter · Public sink: get_kpis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_company, get_transcript, search_transcripts, search_earnings · Private data: get_quarter · Public sink: get_kpis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
